hooks.text: 按升级方向自由选择挂机或主动操作的塔防构筑
hooks.excerpt: Choose if you want to play an idle or more active build by focusing on the upgrades that suit your playstyle and build the perfect tower!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用可控制的AI自动化几乎所有游戏流程
hooks.excerpt: The Perfect Tower II features an AI that will let you automate almost everything so you can focus on discovering new and exciting things!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 探索15个区域和普通、无尽、挑战、挂机、沙盒5种模式
hooks.excerpt: Explore and conquer 15 different regions with 5 unique modes (Normal, Endless, Challenge, Idle, Sandbox)
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 手工重复制作组件非常繁琐

excerpts.excerpt: far to tedious to craft all the componets dozens of times by hand
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 缺少帮助功能说明目标

excerpts.excerpt: the game has no help options to explain what to do
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 投入资源后的效果过小

excerpts.excerpt: grind money, invest for little effect, repeat
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 许多系统沦为耗时刷取

excerpts.excerpt: many other aspects of the game are just tedious timesinks
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: the intended way of progression is so vague
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 教程无法有效指导Era 1之后的进展

excerpts.excerpt: the tutorial is not enough to help in any meaningful way, especially past era 1
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 新玩家很难找到游戏乐趣

excerpts.excerpt: for a new player, the fun of the "game" is hard to find
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 统计数值与实际情况不一致

excerpts.excerpt: the stats are not reflecting what actually happens in the game
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 自定义自动化脚本机制有意思

excerpts.excerpt: interesting mechanics like creating your own automation scripts in a simple programming language
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。

许多系统沦为耗时刷取
